$comment: Flexova validation codes. Normative: every implementation reports exactly these codes (spec/flexova-1.0.md, section 8). Validation runs in phases, in this order. A code marked fatal stops validation once the phase that reported it finishes. Errors make a package invalid; warnings never do.

ZIP_NOT_ZIP.message: The file is not a ZIP archive, or its central directory is unreadable.

ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.message: The archive uses an unsupported ZIP feature (ZIP64, multi-disk, or a compression method other than stored/deflate).

ZIP_ENCRYPTED_ENTRY.message: An entry uses ZIP-level encryption, which Flexova does not allow.

ZIP_TOO_MANY_ENTRIES.message: The archive has more entries than the profile limit allows.

ZIP_UNSAFE_PATH.message: An entry name is absolute, uses a backslash, or contains a '.' or '..' segment.

ZIP_INVALID_NAME.message: An entry name contains characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-/].

ZIP_DUPLICATE_ENTRY.message: Two entries have the same name, ignoring case.

ZIP_SIZE_LIMIT.message: An entry, or the archive in total, exceeds the profile's uncompressed size limit.

ZIP_RATIO_LIMIT.message: An entry's compression ratio exceeds the profile limit (possible zip bomb).

ZIP_MIMETYPE_NOT_FIRST.message: The first entry in the archive must be 'mimetype'.

ZIP_MIMETYPE_COMPRESSED.message: The 'mimetype' entry must be stored uncompressed.

ZIP_MIMETYPE_EXTRA_FIELD.message: The 'mimetype' entry must not have a ZIP extra field.

ZIP_CORRUPT.message: An entry cannot be decompressed, or its size or CRC-32 does not match the archive directory.

OCF_ROOTFILE_MISSING.message: container.xml does not point to an existing package document.

OPF_INVALID.message: The package document is structurally invalid (wrong root, version, or malformed manifest items).

OPF_MISSING_METADATA.message: Required metadata is missing (dc:identifier, dc:title, dc:language or dcterms:modified).

OPF_INVALID_METADATA.message: Metadata has an invalid value (language tag or modification date).

OPF_PROFILE_MISSING.message: The package does not declare the Flexova profile (prefix and flexova:profile meta).

OPF_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED.message: The declared Flexova profile version is not supported.

OPF_A11Y_METADATA_MISSING.message: Accessibility metadata is incomplete (schema:accessMode, accessModeSufficient, accessibilityFeature, accessibilityHazard, accessibilitySummary).

OPF_MISSING_RESOURCE.message: A manifest item points to a file that is not in the archive.

OPF_UNDECLARED_RESOURCE.message: The archive contains a file that the package manifest does not declare.

OPF_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.message: A manifest item has a media type outside the profile's allowed list.

OPF_NAV_MISSING.message: No manifest item has the 'nav' property.

OPF_NAV_INVALID.message: The navigation document has no <nav epub:type="toc">.

OPF_SPINE_INVALID.message: The spine is empty or references an unknown or non-XHTML item.

MAN_INVALID.message: META-INF/flexova.json is not valid JSON or does not match the manifest schema.

MAN_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.message: The manifest declares an unsupported Flexova major version.

MAN_UNSUPPORTED_LEVEL.message: The package protection level is not supported by core Flexova (e.g. a sealed package).

MAN_INVALID_TOKEN.message: A design token has an invalid name or value.

MAN_LOW_CONTRAST.message: A text color has a contrast ratio below 4.5:1 against the background in the light or dark theme.

MAN_HASH_MISMATCH.message: A listed entry is missing, or its size or SHA-256 does not match.

MAN_ENTRIES_INCOMPLETE.message: The manifest's entry list omits files that are in the archive.

XML_MALFORMED.message: The file is not well-formed XML.

XML_ENCODING.message: The file is not UTF-8 encoded.

XML_DTD_FORBIDDEN.message: The file declares a DTD internal subset or entities, which are not allowed.

XML_WRONG_NAMESPACE.message: The document's root element is not in the expected namespace.

CSS_UNSAFE.message: A stylesheet uses @import, remote url(), or script-like constructs.

ASSET_SVG_UNSAFE.message: An SVG image contains script, foreignObject, event handlers or external references.

ASSET_TYPE_MISMATCH.message: An image's content does not match its declared media type.

PRF_FORBIDDEN_ELEMENT.message: The document uses an element that the profile forbids (for example script or iframe).

PRF_UNKNOWN_ELEMENT.message: The document uses an element that the profile does not define.

PRF_FORBIDDEN_ATTRIBUTE.message: The document uses a forbidden attribute (event handler, style, or similar).

PRF_ATTRIBUTE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: An attribute is not allowed on this element.

PRF_INVALID_VALUE.message: An attribute value is not valid for its type.

PRF_MISSING_ALT.message: An image has no alt attribute (use alt="" for decorative images).

PRF_CONTENT_MODEL.message: An element's children do not match its content model.

PRF_DUPLICATE_ID.message: Two elements in the same document share an id.

PRF_TOO_DEEP.message: Elements are nested deeper than the profile limit.

PRF_REMOTE_RESOURCE.message: A resource is loaded from outside the package; every resource must be embedded.

PRF_BROKEN_REFERENCE.message: A resource reference points to a file that the package manifest does not declare.

PRF_BROKEN_LINK.message: An internal link points to a missing document or fragment.

PRF_HEADING_SKIP.message: Heading levels skip a level (for example h1 followed by h3).

PRF_TABLE_NO_HEADERS.message: A table has no header cells (th).
